dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are there many saurians with marks on their horns...?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: No, there's perhaps one every dozen years, or even several dozen years, but no one's keeping count...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: Either they get "concealed" by their tribes, or they make their way to the volcano. The few that survive are only mentioned in legends...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: But their situation is *cough* ... less than good. Many of them grow violent and are killed by saurian-hunters...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: However *cough* ... it seems that in times when the taint of the Abyss grows stronger, the Flamelord's Blessing appears on the horns of ever more saurians...
